name: Enrich a Person
description: Enrich a single person's data using Apollo's People Enrichment API. Match by email, name+domain, LinkedIn URL, or Apollo person ID. Returns title, employer, employment history, location, seniority, and more.

firstName.description: First name (use with lastName and domain for best results)

domain.description: Employer domain (no www. or @). Example: apollo.io

apolloPersonId.description: Apollo person ID (from a previous search)

revealPersonalEmails.description: Set true to reveal personal emails (consumes credits, blocked in GDPR regions)

steps.name: Extract and format enriched person data
